title: Still Saying "How Do You Do?" Textbook English vs Real English #shorts
description:
Textbook English vs real English: "How do you do?" Hardly anyone says that anymore - it sounds a hundred years old. What people really say when they meet someone:
• Nice to meet you!
• More casual: Hey, good to meet you!

"How do you do?" is still heard in very formal introductions.
